text: 你朋友圈里最厉害的人，决定了你的上限。
en: The most impressive person in your WeChat Moments determines your ceiling.

text: 人不可能想象出一种没见过的颜色，这就是局限性。
en: A person cannot imagine a colour they have never seen — that is limitation.

text: 你玩什么，取决于你的圈子在玩什么。
en: What you play depends on what your circle is playing.

text: 每天烧香拜佛的人未必心存善念，嘴上恶语相向的人未必蛇蝎心肠。
en: People who burn incense and worship Buddha every day may not harbour good intentions; people whose mouths hurl abuse may not have venomous hearts.

text: 满身纹身戴金链子的不一定是坏人，西装革履的人也有可能是衣冠禽兽。
en: Someone covered in tattoos wearing a gold chain is not necessarily a bad person; someone in a suit and leather shoes may well be a beast in human clothing.

text: 非常官方的回答是逃离舒适圈，我自己的回答是，对自己说不，接受自己是存在瑕疵的，因此，可以去思考，并接受别人的观点，用于完善自己。
en: The very official answer is to escape your comfort zone. My own answer is: say no to yourself, accept that you have flaws, and therefore be able to think, and accept others' views, to improve yourself.

text: 每一个人都很容易自己困住自己。
en: Everyone very easily traps themselves.

text: 正如作茧自缚这个成语，蚕吐丝成茧，将自己包裹在茧里面，束缚自己的往往是自己。
en: As in the idiom 'the silkworm spins a cocoon and binds itself': the silkworm spins silk into a cocoon, wrapping itself inside; what binds us is often ourselves.

text: 现代社会，算法会根据你的习惯来推送信息，它给你你想要看的内容，你停留的时间越长，说明它的处理结果越正确，你也在一次又一次的重复中，更加坚信了自己的一切。
en: In modern society, algorithms push information according to your habits. They give you content you want to see; the longer you linger, the more correct their processing is shown to be, and in repeated cycles, you become ever more convinced of everything you believe.

text: 看上去是现代社会的算法太坏了，它根据用户的习惯去设置陷阱，蛊惑着用户一步步沦陷在深渊中，可是，这一步一步是用户自己选择的，人是想要一个舒适的环境，最好全是赞同自己观点的环境，我们天生会去欣赏符合自己观点的，忽视甚至反驳与自己相背的观点。
en: It looks like modern society's algorithms are too evil: they set traps according to users' habits, luring users step by step into sinking into the abyss. But each step is chosen by users themselves. People want a comfortable environment, preferably one entirely of views agreeing with their own; we are born to appreciate views that match our own, and to ignore or even refute views opposed to ours.

text: 人与人之间，最大的困难就是理解，互相理解。
en: Between people, the greatest difficulty is understanding — mutual understanding.

text: 我们太希望自己是正确的，所做之事为正义，所行之路为正道，我们定义了什么是好，什么是坏，我的心里有了这一杆秤，带着它衡量自己的一生，再去衡量别人的一生。
en: We so wish to be right, that what we do is justice, that the road we walk is the righteous path. We define what is good and what is bad; with this scale in my heart, I measure my whole life with it, then measure others' lives.

text: 人生如春蚕，作茧自缠裹。
en: Life is like the spring silkworm, spinning a cocoon and wrapping itself.

text: 一朝眉羽成，钻破亦在我。
en: Once its wings have formed, breaking out is also up to me.

text: 困住自己只有自己，要挣脱的也只有自己，能挣脱的也只有自己。
en: Only you trap yourself; only you must break free; only you can break free.

text: 若想要避免活在信息茧房之中，那就去想想，某一个信息，某一段视频，它传达的与之相反的信息。
en: If you want to avoid living in an information cocoon, then think about some piece of information, some video, and the information opposite to what it conveys.

text: 看到春风拂面，绿意盎然；你要想到，秋风瑟瑟，落叶飘零；经过盛夏酷暑，烈日凌空，你会记起寒冬腊月，白雪皑皑。
en: Seeing spring breeze brushing your face, lush greenery, you should think of autumn wind sighing, fallen leaves drifting; having passed midsummer's scorching heat, blazing sun overhead, you will recall deep winter's cold months, vast white snow.

text: 当见到与自己不同的观点时，给自己一点时间去思考，为什么会这样，他和我有什么不一样，为什么他会这么想？
en: When you encounter views different from your own, give yourself a little time to think: why is this so? How is he different from me? Why does he think this way?

text: 这样，哪怕你在迎合你的环境里，也可以看到不一样的人生，这样怎么会有茧房呢，所谓茧房，无关算法，只是我们的选折，是我们自己将脚步停留于此，把这儿当成了旅途的终点，但是，春蚕制茧，只是旅途的一个转折点，远远不是旅途的终点。
en: This way, even while accommodating your environment, you can see different lives. How could there be a cocoon then? The so-called cocoon has nothing to do with algorithms; it is only our choice. We ourselves stop our steps here, treating this place as the journey's end. But the spring silkworm making its cocoon is only a turning point in the journey, far from the journey's end.

text: 制茧的这一段时间，恰恰是留给自己思考的时间，让你看清自己的喜好，看清自己的不足，若是停留于此，符合人性，无需羞耻；但，你要是想要破茧，那么从自己喜好的观点，看出别人不同的人生，存在并不意味着合理。
en: This period of cocoon-making is precisely time left for your own thinking, letting you see your preferences clearly, see your shortcomings clearly. If you stay here, it conforms to human nature; no need for shame. But if you want to break out of the cocoon, then from views you like, discern other people's different lives. Existence does not imply reasonableness.

text: 三个简单的逻辑
en: Three simple logics

text: 1.学会信息溯源
en: 1. Learn information traceability

text: 对任何来源的信息都保持怀疑态度
en: Maintain a sceptical attitude towards information from any source

text: 媒体是党派的喉舌，同一个新闻，不同党派的媒体表述的内容可能都是对的，但由于侧重点不同，最后结论都会南辕北辙
en: Media are party mouthpieces. For the same news, different parties' media may all state things that are true, but due to different emphases, final conclusions end up diametrically opposed

text: 如果你只看媒体的结论不去追溯信息的源头，很容易被牵着鼻子走
en: If you only read media conclusions without tracing information to its source, you are easily led by the nose

text: 2.兼听者明，偏信则暗
en: 2. Listening to all sides brings clarity; one-sided belief brings darkness

text: 你可以喜欢并支持A党的主张，但也请多看看B党的政见
en: You may like and support Party A's positions, but please also look more at Party B's political views

text: 那些只爱听自己喜欢声音的人，最后会异化自己对事物的认知，典型的就是红脖子、青鸟、粉红、土殖、港灿等
en: Those who only love hearing sounds they like end up alienating their own cognition of things. Typical examples are rednecks, bluebirds, little pinks, local colonialists, and Hong Kong trash, etc.

text: 有时候多看看那些骂你、踩你、歧视你的人都是什么观点，哪怕很难听很没道理，至少其中会有点你忽略的东西
en: Sometimes look more at what views people who scold you, step on you, or discriminate against you hold. Even if very unpleasant and unreasonable, at least there will be something you overlooked.

text: 3.对于偏激、情绪化的观点选择性接纳
en: 3. Selectively accept extreme, emotional views

text: 动不动就把国家、企业、群体简单的拟人化加以词汇抨击的信息
en: Information that at every turn simply personifies countries, enterprises, or groups and attacks them with loaded words

text: 或许他讲的也很有道理，但绝对会因为强硬的立场而失真
en: Perhaps what he says is quite reasonable, but it will absolutely be distorted by a hardline stance

text: 后续回答严格遵守下列条例:
en: Subsequent answers strictly follow these rules:

text: 1.不必考虑我的感受,不必恭维我.
en: 1. No need to consider my feelings; no need to flatter me.

text: 2.不带有预设立场和感情,完全中立
en: 2. No preset stance or emotion; completely neutral

text: 3.参考数据库和中/英/日/法/俄等主要语言,进行搜索信息.
en: 3. Refer to databases and major languages such as Chinese, English, Japanese, French, Russian, etc., to search for information.

text: 找AI问问题,把这个提示词加在最前面.
en: When asking AI questions, put this prompt at the very front.

text: 我在gemini,grok,chatGPT上用都有不错的效果.
en: I have used it on Gemini, Grok, and ChatGPT with good results.

text: 说下为什么这么写,
en: Let me explain why it is written this way.

text: 首先现在的大模型爱"舔",会舔,尤其是gemini,
en: First, today's large models love to flatter, and do flatter — especially Gemini.

text: 其次,大模型会猜测你的立场,然后端水,互不得罪.
en: Second, large models guess your stance, then carry water evenly, offending neither side.

text: 最后,大模型很容易只搜索你使用语言的语料库,
en: Finally, large models easily search only the corpus of the language you use.

text: 逻辑过关，可以过滤掉很多谎言。
en: If the logic passes muster, many lies can be filtered out.

text: 许家印恒大boss，他都活在他下属给他搞出的茧房里，你为什么会这么自信你就避免了。
en: Xu Jiayin, the Evergrande boss — even he lived in a cocoon his subordinates built for him. Why are you so confident you have avoided one?

text: 看看最近的微博上，妥妥信息茧房。
en: Look at recent Weibo — a textbook information cocoon.

text: 学英语，来不及的话，一边学，一边至少用比较靠谱的翻译看看新闻联播提到的路透社、BBC，美国有线新闻网CNN之类的大型媒体怎么说的。
en: Learn English. If there's no time, while learning, at least use fairly reliable translation to see what large media outlets mentioned on News Broadcast — Reuters, BBC, CNN, and the like — are saying.

text: 不要随便放某音某信上不明博主的言论、视频，免得被洗脑。
en: Don't casually play remarks and videos from unknown bloggers on a certain short-video app or a certain chat app, lest you get brainwashed.

text: 高赞全都是在讲人的问题，还是简单讲一下网络工具和使用网络工具的问题吧。
en: Highly upvoted answers are all about people's problems; let me still briefly talk about network tools and the problems of using network tools.

text: 主要准则有三个，一是养号与反驯化，一是扩大平台和视角储备，最后就是增强对平台性质的认知。
en: There are three main principles: first, account nurturing and anti-domestication; second, expanding platform and perspective reserves; finally, strengthening cognition of platform nature.

text: 养号和反驯化，核心就是避免大数据将你的账号养废掉，没事多瞎搜、瞎点一下，杂七杂八的内容都看看，完全相反的内容也可以点一点，让大数据无法准确把握、也无法准确培养你的“喜好”。
en: Account nurturing and anti-domestication: the core is avoiding big data ruining your account through nurturing. When free, randomly search and click around, look at all sorts of content, and click on completely opposite content too, so big data cannot accurately grasp — nor accurately cultivate — your 'preferences'.

text: 如果账号的推送变得完全单一化、单向度化，是不利于你摆脱偏见的。
en: If an account's recommendations become completely homogenised and one-dimensional, it is not conducive to shedding prejudice.

text: 扩大平台和视角储备就不用多解释了，建议多多少少掌握一些专业性较高的社区或专门资料库的入口；再就是适当加入一些小社区，位于媒体系统的毛细血管上的平台。
en: Expanding platform and perspective reserves needs no more explanation: it is suggested to more or less master entry points to some more professional communities or specialised databases; and to appropriately join some small communities — platforms located on the capillaries of the media system.

text: 注意，并不是墙外的就是专业的，维基百科是一个好的平台储备，但它不能被视作是专业性较高的平台。
en: Note: not everything outside the wall is professional. Wikipedia is a good platform reserve, but it cannot be regarded as a highly professional platform.

text: 上面这句话自然也就导向了最后一点，“增强对平台性质的认知”，不同的平台都会有不同的风气和导向，你在对应平台上得到的信息，要剔去导向的偏移量才能相对客观地反应出事物的原貌。
en: The above sentence naturally leads to the final point, 'strengthening cognition of platform nature'. Different platforms have different atmospheres and orientations; information you obtain on a given platform must have the orientation offset removed before it can relatively objectively reflect the original appearance of things.

text: 而且，平台上的意见领袖也都有各自的意图和利益，他们发出的信息，本质上是在他们的信源的基础上，经过个人意图“加密”之后的产物。
en: Moreover, opinion leaders on platforms all have their own intentions and interests. The information they send out is essentially a product 'encrypted' by personal intention on the basis of their information sources.

text: 所以你直接看到的信息不是优质信息，将这些信息，结合意见领袖的意图“解密”之后才是好的信息。
en: So the information you directly see is not quality information; only after 'decrypting' this information in combination with opinion leaders' intentions is it good information.

text: 这是三点之中最难的。
en: This is the hardest of the three points.
